sourceBuild.matrixCommand: moui build ios showcase --sdk iphonesimulator --mobile-config examples/showcase/moui.mobile.json
sourceBuild.evidence: installable simulator .app built from HEAD via `moui build ios --sdk iphonesimulator` + clang++ direct link (21MB, adhoc-signed), installed via simctl and launched on the iPhone 17 simulator (iOS 26.3, arm64); artifacts/ios/. NOTE: omitting --sdk iphonesimulator silently links a device-platform binary (LC_BUILD_VERSION platform=IOS) that SpringBoard rejects with 'not valid application' / launch error 163 — the simulator SDK flag is mandatory.

presenterEvidence.reference: Skia-rendered probe UI screenshots on the matching iPhone 17 simulator (iOS 26.3) through the CPU blit presenter: the runtime frame is wrapped as a CGImage and swapped into view.layer.contents (window/modules/window/ios/native_ios_host.c 'Soft present: bitmap on the main layer'); idb-driven probe interactions (tap/text/keys) render through it. The metal-direct GPU route (policy default in native_gpu_policy.mbt) is not claimed yet — the GPU seven-gate promotion stays a separate renderer item, the same standing the HarmonyOS GPU gap had at ADR 0046.
